tasks.title: Remove .bak files and organize project structure
tasks.description: Clean up the codebase by removing all .bak files and establishing a proper project structure
tasks.details: Remove all .bak files from the codebase (ActivityTimeline.tsx.bak, BranchHealthVisualization.tsx.bak, etc.). Organize components into proper directories following atomic design pattern. Set up .gitignore rules to prevent future .bak file commits.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all .bak files are removed using find command. Ensure project builds successfully. Check that no functionality is broken by running existing tests.

tasks.title: Configure TypeScript strict mode and linting rules
tasks.description: Set up TypeScript strict mode and ESLint rules to prevent React.FC usage
tasks.details: Enable TypeScript strict mode in tsconfig.json. Configure ESLint rules to warn against React.FC usage. Set up pre-commit hooks to enforce these rules. Document the new coding standards.
tasks.testStrategy: Run TypeScript compiler with strict mode enabled. Verify ESLint catches React.FC patterns. Test pre-commit hooks block commits with violations.

tasks.title: Refactor large components - RepositoryHealthModal
tasks.description: Break down RepositoryHealthModal (963 lines) into smaller, composable components
tasks.details: Extract business logic into custom hooks. Create separate components for different sections (health metrics, charts, actions). Implement proper prop drilling prevention with context. Target < 300 lines per component.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify component functionality remains intact. Check that all interactions work as before. Measure component sizes to ensure < 300 lines. Run performance tests to ensure no regression.

tasks.title: Refactor large components - TaskModal
tasks.description: Break down TaskModal (712 lines) into smaller, reusable components
tasks.details: Split TaskModal into TaskForm, TaskDetails, TaskActions components. Extract validation logic into custom hooks. Implement proper state management. Create reusable form components.
tasks.testStrategy: Test all task CRUD operations work correctly. Verify form validation behaves as expected. Check modal interactions and animations. Ensure no performance degradation.

tasks.title: Remove React.FC anti-patterns
tasks.description: Replace all 185 instances of React.FC with direct function components
tasks.details: Systematically replace React.FC patterns with proper function component definitions. Update component prop types to use interface definitions. Ensure children props are explicitly typed where needed.
tasks.testStrategy: Use grep to verify no React.FC patterns remain. Run TypeScript compiler to check for type errors. Execute full test suite to ensure no regressions.

tasks.title: Implement route-based code splitting
tasks.description: Add React.lazy and Suspense for route-level code splitting
tasks.details: Implement React.lazy for all route components. Add proper Suspense boundaries with loading states. Configure Vite for optimal chunk splitting. Target 30% bundle size reduction.
tasks.testStrategy: Measure bundle sizes before and after implementation. Verify lazy loading works correctly. Test loading states appear properly. Check network tab for proper chunk loading.

tasks.title: Implement missing task creation functionality
tasks.description: Complete the TODO for task creation modal and API integration
tasks.details: Implement full task creation flow in TaskModal. Add API endpoints for task creation. Handle validation and error states. Add optimistic updates for better UX.
tasks.testStrategy: Test task creation end-to-end. Verify API integration works correctly. Test error handling for various failure scenarios. Check optimistic updates and rollback.

tasks.title: Add data export functionality
tasks.description: Implement missing export features for tasks and analytics
tasks.details: Add export buttons to relevant components. Implement CSV and JSON export formats. Create backend endpoints for data export. Add proper error handling and progress indicators.
tasks.testStrategy: Test export functionality for different data types. Verify exported files are correctly formatted. Test large data exports for performance. Check error handling for edge cases.

tasks.title: Optimize performance and add monitoring
tasks.description: Implement memoization, virtual scrolling, and performance monitoring
tasks.details: Add React.memo to expensive components. Implement virtual scrolling for long lists. Set up performance monitoring with React DevTools Profiler. Add web vitals tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Measure render performance before and after optimization. Test virtual scrolling with large datasets. Verify memoization prevents unnecessary re-renders. Check Lighthouse scores > 90.

tasks.title: Add comprehensive test coverage and accessibility
tasks.description: Achieve 80% test coverage and full accessibility compliance
tasks.details: Write unit tests for all components and hooks. Add integration tests for critical user flows. Implement E2E tests with Playwright. Perform accessibility audit and add ARIA labels.
tasks.testStrategy: Run coverage reports to verify 80% threshold. Execute axe accessibility tests. Run E2E tests in multiple browsers. Perform manual keyboard navigation testing.
